card.name: Words just before ion-channel drug terms
card.fires_on: Small words or word starts that come right before a drug target or ion term, such as 'of' before calcium ions, 'N' before NMDA or nifedipine, and 'block' contexts. Seen in drug-interaction and warning text.

modes.label: Before calcium ions
modes.description: The word 'of' after 'inward movement', just before calcium ions.
modes.example: depress cardiovascular activity by decreasing the inward movement<< of>> calcium ions.

modes.label: Start of N-drug names
modes.description: The letter N starting NMDA or nifedipine after 'block' or 'calcium channel blockers'.

modes.label: Linking verb before a drug or lab term
modes.description: Words like 'contains' or 'including' that lead into a drug name or electrolyte finding.
modes.example: AUVELITY<< contains>> bupropion, which can cause

card.writes: It suppresses ion and sodium words, so it keeps the next word from being a plain ion term.
card.plain: It fires on small words right before calcium-channel or NMDA drug terms, steering away from saying 'ion' next.
